Configuring and managing a Multi-AZ deployment for Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployments can have one standby or two standby DB instances [1]. When the deployment has one standby DB instance, it's called a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment [1]. A Multi-AZ DB instance deployment has one standby DB instance that provides failover support, but doesn't serve read traffic [1]. When the deployment has two standby DB instances, it's called a Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment [1]. A Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment has standby DB instances that provide failover support and can also serve read traffic [1].

For each instance-level row, the value of Multi-AZ is 3 Zones [2].

O serviço distribui fluxos de entrada para instâncias de pool de back-end, de acordo com regras de balanceamento de carga e sondas de integridade configuradas [2]. Um balanceador de carga funciona na camada de aplicação, a sétima camada do modelo Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) [4]. Após receber uma solicitação, ele avalia as regras do listener em ordem de prioridade para determinar qual regra aplicar e, em seguida, seleciona um alvo do grupo de destino para a ação da regra [4].
